typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Status as string,
		{Incident Opened} as timestamp,
		{Related Ticket} as string,
		{Copy of Incident Resolution} as string,
		{HE Categories} as string,
		{Root Cause of Incident} as string,
		{Maintenance Construction Human Error (CPG Only)} as string,
		{Responsible Group} as string,
		{Preventative Action} as string,
		{Additional Comments} as string,
		{Action Owners} as string,
		{Incident Closed} as timestamp,
		{Incident Statement} as string,
		{IT Impact} as string,
		{Site Alias} as string,
		{Action(s) Identified} as string,
		{Site Type} as string,
		Published as string,
		{Owner Group} as string,
		ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Status as string,
		IncidentOpened as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RelatedTicket as string,
		IncidentResolution as string,
		HECategories as string,
		RootCauseofIncident as string,
		MaintenanceConstructionHumanError as string,
		ResponsibleGroup as string,
		PreventativeAction as string,
		AdditionalComments as string,
		ActionOwners as string,
		IncidentClosed as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		IncidentStatement as string,
		ITImpact as string,
		SiteAlias as string,
		ActionIdentified as string,
		SiteType as string,
		Published as string,
		OwnerGroup as string,
		ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		IncidentOpened = {Incident Opened},
		RelatedTicket = {Related Ticket},
		IncidentResolution = {Copy of Incident Resolution},
		HECategories = {HE Categories},
		RootCauseofIncident = {Root Cause of Incident},
		MaintenanceConstructionHumanError = {Maintenance Construction Human Error (CPG Only)},
		ResponsibleGroup = {Responsible Group},
		PreventativeAction = {Preventative Action},
		AdditionalComments = {Additional Comments},
		ActionOwners = {Action Owners},
		IncidentClosed = {Incident Closed},
		IncidentStatement = {Incident Statement},
		ITImpact = {IT Impact},
		SiteAlias = {Site Alias},
		ActionIdentified = {Action(s) Identified},
		SiteType = {Site Type},
		Published,
		OwnerGroup = {Owner Group},
		ID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
